_comment: Guided tour for the legacy export tool.

steps.title: What this does
steps.text: Legacy export writes the old formats (Seidel/Margarita .bur/.bg4, burst-wise CSV) out of a .pto project or a burst result — the bridge colleagues without ChiSurf still need.

steps.title: Choose the source
steps.text: The list shows what the running session holds: the open project and its burst-selection results. Pick the one to export.

steps.title: Choose the format
steps.text: Format picks the target: .bur/.bg4 for the Seidel/Margarita tools, CSV for spreadsheets.

steps.title: Export
steps.text: Press Export and choose where to write. The .pto project stays the record — the export is a view for one colleague, not a backup.
